method.name: multiformat_bounded_serial_anchors_v1
method.assumptions: Published odds describe one eligible copy per hit. Nominal serial ceilings are substantially represented across the listed formats. All format pack counts are nonnegative. Constraints allow 3% anchor disagreement; this is a model sensitivity envelope, not a confidence interval. Shared reserve/subject omissions could bias all anchors. Standalone per-format production is not identified.
